supersedes: G013_FS_EFFICIENCY_CLOSURE.json (v1, same day) - THAT RECEIPT WAS WRONG
what_v1_got_wrong: v1 used STORAGE BPW (0.6462, averaged over all 512 experts) as if it were the BPW decode actually moves. At batch=1 only 10 of 512 experts are read per token, so storage BPW understates per-token traffic by ~4x.

v1 accepted 560-647 GB/s as the achievable band. That band came from a REUSE-friendly pattern. A no-model control in the real decode shape (98 CBs, 10-of-512 gather, unique bytes once) reaches only 320-411 GB/s.

The 0.135% efficiency figure was a CATEGORY ERROR: it divided a mixed-artifact storage floor (212.53 fs at 1.392467 BPW) by a Q4-VEHICLE runtime (156,970 fs). Two different vehicles. Same-vehicle Q4 wall rate is 3.38 GB/s = 0.413% of peak, 1.1% of the honest control.

measured_control.method: no model logic; same unique bytes, same 98-command-buffer topology, same 10-of-512 gather
measured_control.note: 819 GB/s is the published peak and is NOT reachable in this access shape

per_token_byte_budget_verified.independent_cross_check: Every class matches receipts/QWEN80_TOKEN_NS_LEDGER.json theoretical_weight_bytes to within 0.03%: attention 818,036,736 vs 818,151,424; lm_head 165,306,368 vs 165,329,552; router 26,738,688 vs 26,742,448; routed experts = Q4 802,160,640 scaled by the 7.951x expert BPW ratio = 100,885,362 vs 100,915,200. The lane did not author that ledger, so this is genuine independent corroboration.

THE_HEADLINE: Attention + lm_head are 86-88% of the bytes moved per token. Routed experts are 9%. The entire density campaign has been compressing the 9%.

active_bpw.note: NOT the storage figures 0.6462 and 1.4444. Storage averages over experts that decode never touches.

sub_100_fs_requirement_restated.must_include: attention and lm_head, which are the dominant mass - not just experts
sub_100_fs_requirement_restated.v1_claimed: 0.448-0.518 storage BPW - WRONG on both the mass and the ceiling

verdict: Sub-100 fs/weight is UNREACHABLE on this box with any existing Q80 pack. The best existing artifact bottoms out at 765-985 fs even with a perfect load-only kernel, and at 384 fs even at an unachievable unity bandwidth. A proven negative with arithmetic, which the contract defines as a success.
consequence_for_TPS_not_just_fs: This also redirects G001/G020. Crushing unused experts cannot move either fs/weight or TPS, because experts are 9% of per-token bytes. Attention at 73% is the only mass whose compression changes the token time.
